exposure: Mode of delivery (elective vs emergency caesarean section)
Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, caesarean section (elective and emergency))
finding: Children born by caesarean section, particularly elective caesarean section, had a higher risk of severe astigmatism compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: Children born by elective caesarean section had an 87.3% increased risk of severe astigmatism, while those born by emergency caesarean section did not differ significantly from vaginally delivered children.
